stem.text: The diagram shows the brake system of a car.

stem.alt: Hydraulic brake system: a brake pedal piston on the right is connected by pipes to four brake pistons on the left, each with a leftward force arrow; labels read force from pistons on brakes and force from foot on brake pedal

stem.text: The pipes are filled with incompressible liquid. When a force is applied to the brake pedal, the pressure in the liquid increases and applies a force to each of the four wheels.
The area of the piston connected to the brake pedal is $8\,\text{cm}^{2}$.
The area of each piston connected to the brakes is $12\,\text{cm}^{2}$.
A force of $800\,\text{N}$ is applied by the foot to the brake pedal.
What is the force applied to each brake?
